I don't even know how to begin this review, because every time I think about everything this clinic has done for me and my pets… I feel like crying. Truly.

They don't just care for animals here… they care for hearts.

They were there for me when my Nero passed away, and I will never forget the humanity, patience, and love with which they supported me during that difficult time. And with my Tabata… they have been one angel after another. In every surgery, every treatment, every scare, they have always been there, explaining things to me, supporting me, comforting me with their words and their work.

I don't have enough words to thank them.

Thank you for everything you have done for my babies.

Thank you for supporting me when I couldn't.

Thank you for being a place where you feel love, respect, and true dedication.

From the bottom of my heart… you are the best.

We have been clients of Pets and Vets for over 12 years - 4 dogs in total to date.   One crazy biter who had to be muzzled each visit, one with serious medical issues late in life and the 2 sisters we have now.  Dr. Andreu and his staff have always worked through each dog’s personality and treated them as animal lovers would, with patience and care.

In October. 2023, 5.5 yr old Arya woke up, stretch and was paralyzed in her back half. We took her straight to Pets & Vets and Doc immediately took her in, accessed her injury and even made calls to get an  MRI. Long story short, between surgeons in WPB and neurologists in S. Miami, through every step Doc was always there supporting and advising, even when 1 facility suggested to euthanize.

Arya was diagnosed with FCE,  a spinal bruise with a prognosis of "maybe she’ll walk again.” Surgery could not fix damage. Treatment course was Physical Therapy, other therapies and time.
We looked at other PT facilities but the expense was more than double and the drive was about an hour each way. It took a toll so we decided to continue PT/OT with Pets & Vets. They were very accommodating and went above and beyond. (They still are.) Every question was answered completely and every treatment option was discussed in length.

It’s been a slow-go with a couple of UTIs and minor setbacks, but with acupuncture, laser therapy, hydro therapy at Pets & Vets 2-3 times/week, along with exercise, home therapy and diet change, Arya regained complete feeling in both her hind legs. We still have a long way to go for her to stand up and walk on her own again but she would not have come this far without Dr. Andreu and his wonderful crew. We are all committed to see her run around again.

You would think that after all these trips and treatments, Arya would run away from the office. She doesn't as they treat her like a queen.

Thanks for everything, Doc. You’re the best. :)

PS - This is for real.

Everyone has different experiences, but I can truly say from the heart that I trust Dr. Andreu and his team 100%. I’ve been bringing my pets and rescue dogs to Pets and Vets Clinic for over 10 years, and ever since Dr. Andreu has been in charge, I’ve always received care filled with compassion, respect, and professionalism.

Dr. Andreu and his team are very dedicated professionals who clearly love what they do. Their commitment and experience are evident in every situation. One of the most memorable moments was when I rescued a dog with serious wounds, no other veterinarian was able to determine what was wrong. But Dr. Andreu, just by examining him, identified that the dog had tetanus. He immediately began treatment and even gave me a break with part of the bill because he knew this was a rescue. That dog is alive today thanks to him.

I’ve rescued many dogs over the years, and I always bring them to Pets and Vets they treat each dog with care, patience, and a genuine heart. I’m deeply grateful for everything they have done, and I wouldn’t trust my pets with anyone else.

Serious concerns about ethical conduct, medical accuracy, and record handling.
I trusted this clinic during a very vulnerable time, and the experience raised major red flags:
•	My dog was diagnosed with epilepsy — a diagnosis later contradicted — which negatively impacted his insurance eligibility.
•	A vaccine was administered in the hind leg, causing tissue necrosis. It was later labeled as an “allergic reaction,” deflecting responsibility.
•	Medical records were transferred and altered between my name and my elderly mother’s, without clear medical or legal justification.
•	After years as a respectful, paying client, I received a sudden service termination letter without reason — suggesting personal motives rather than professional grounds.

Additionally, I observed an unusual pattern of glowing reviews being posted around the time of my complaint — some of which have since been removed by Google due to authenticity concerns. This further impacts the trustworthiness of the clinic’s public image.

Clients deserve ethical care, honest communication, and transparency — especially when it concerns the health of their pets.
